status: FROZEN v2 — amended per user approval 2026-09-12; nothing computed at time of freezing
authority_order: 1. frozen plans (P512W/frozen_sampling_plan.json, P512X/frozen_reconstruction_plan.json, P512Y/frozen_tso_plan.json) define thresholds and rules
2. primary artifacts (.sol, prepared_mapping.json, preserved fixture models, IPOPT logs) supply every number
3. report prose is CHECKED against 1 and 2; it is never a source
disclosed_gaps_motivating_this_stage: TARGET_cycle20 (W): interface quantities were NEVER measured, yet the corrected multi-axis table in P5_12_X_COMPARATOR_BREADTH_REPORT.md records its interface axis as EQUIVALENT. Asserted, not measured.

TSO case9 (Y): interface compared on expected_interface_vmag only; prepared_mapping.json shows expected_interface_pf_p (72) and expected_interface_pf_q (72) also present. Partial by omission, not by structure. The earlier 'consistent with a transmission block's interface role' rationale is FALSE and is withdrawn.

Column set: the frozen W plan says the primal metric is taken 'over the 9166 IPOPT optimization columns', but the reported W/X/Y numbers were computed over the full NL primal vector (9268 / 9268 / 3036). This deviation is disclosed and both sets are computed below.
Planning weight for TARGET_cycle20 (2025 Spring, D=92) was never computed; only X and Y (2025 Autumn/Summer, D=91) were.

Y_TSO_case9_cycle7.ladder_authorization: user-approved before execution: +/-10x around this fixture's own historical baseline 1e-6

column_sets.C_nl: every primal entry in the .sol, in NL column order; size = n from the .sol header
column_sets.C_opt: OPERATIONAL per fixture: C_nl minus the equal-bound set (preserved-model bounds with lb == ub exactly) that IPOPT removes under default fixed_variable_treatment=make_parameter
column_sets.cross_check: |C_opt| must equal the 'Total number of variables' reported in that fixture's own IPOPT log; expected W 9166, X 9168, Y 2934 against NL 9268/9268/3036, i.e. 102/100/102 removed
column_sets.do_not_inherit_literal_9166: the frozen W plan's phrase names a count valid only for W; it must not be applied to X or Y
column_sets.record: emit n_nl, n_opt, n_removed for every fixture
column_sets.fixture_property: the 100-vs-102 difference is recorded as a fixture property alongside the fixture-dependent c-scaling (Arm A and DSO case33_2 'c scaling provided'; TSO case9 'No c scaling provided'); both are modelling-invariant conditioning differences between blocks

normalization.per_column: d_i = |x_i - b_i| / max(1, |b_i|)  (b = baseline arm, x = perturbed arm)
normalization.metric: max_scaled_primal = max_i d_i over the stated column set
auxiliary: argmax column index and component name via symbol map
family histogram of d_i > 1e-3 by component-name prefix
top-6 movers with base and perturbed values
signed pairwise cancellation for the top-2 movers if they share a component family and opposite sign

interface_families_in_scope.selection_rule: variables only (symbol starts with 'v'); the corresponding *_def entries are constraint rows and are excluded
interface_families_in_scope.requirement: ALL families present in a fixture's prepared_mapping.json MUST be compared; the output must list families_found and families_compared per fixture so partial coverage is recorded, never inferred
interface_families_in_scope.metric: per family, max over its entries of d_i, using the same normalization

objective.source: final unscaled 'Objective...............:' value in each arm's IPOPT log (data/SRP1/Results/P512{W,X,Y}/<arm>/logs/*.log)

planning_weight.formula: w = N_year * D_day * annualization, annualization = 1 / (1 + discount)^(year - year0)
planning_weight.use: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY; must not redefine any threshold

threshold_application.interface: same three-region rule applied per family and aggregated as the worst family
threshold_application.branch: declared only if primal > 1e-3 AND relative objective > 1e-3
threshold_application.path: material if |d_iterations| / baseline_iterations > 0.5, or restoration entries appear/disappear, or safeguard count changes between zero and nonzero
threshold_application.note: completing an unfinished interface measurement under these unchanged thresholds is a COMPLETION, not a threshold revision

W_baseline_dual_derivation.baseline_symbol_map: data/SRP1/Results/P512R/cycle20_prepared/original_mapping.json (the baseline's OWN map; nothing borrowed from a variant directory)
W_baseline_dual_derivation.precondition_gate: sha256(P512R/cycle20_prepared/original.nl) must equal sha256 of both W arms' prepared.nl (expected fbe9e6e846f6b5b5...6817dbda); equal NL bytes imply a shared symbol map BY CONSTRUCTION
W_baseline_dual_derivation.consequence: given that gate passes, a method A vs method B disagreement is a BUG TO REPORT, not an ambiguity to adjudicate
W_baseline_dual_derivation.method_A: index-order: column i <-> symbol 'v{i}' in SolverResults.solution(0).variable
W_baseline_dual_derivation.method_B: symbol-map-mediated: symbol -> component name -> SolverResults value, compared component-wise against the arm .sol value for the same component
W_baseline_dual_derivation.requirement: report both; on disagreement identify which assumption fails

outputs.per_number: every emitted number carries its source artifact path
outputs.discrepancy_list: each report-prose value that fails to reproduce is listed as a REPORT CORRECTION with both values and the artifact that settles it

policies.no_solve: zero solver calls; p512_k install_solver_guards armed and asserted at 0 for OptSolver.solve and SystemCallSolver._execute_command
policies.mismatch: any mismatch is a report correction, never a script adjustment; the script is not tuned to match prose
policies.writes: only under data/SRP1/Results/P512Z/; note that this stage does NOT call fresh_planning, so no diagram side effects are expected

gap3_attribution.statement: the previously reported W/X/Y primal numbers may have been computed over C_nl rather than C_opt
gap3_attribution.basis: Planner recollection of an unpreserved ad-hoc step; not readable from any artifact

predeclared_outcomes.C_nl_reproduces: supports the hypothesis that the unpreserved step used C_nl
predeclared_outcomes.C_opt_reproduces: refutes it; the unpreserved step used C_opt and the frozen-plan wording was honoured
predeclared_outcomes.neither_reproduces: a third cause; report as an open discrepancy and do not attribute

gap3_attribution.rule: do not record a cause ahead of the evidence

implementation_notes.variable_vs_constraint: discriminate by mapping KEY PREFIX ('v' = variable, 'c' = constraint), never by a name suffix such as '_def'. The mapping is one flat list holding variables, constraints and the objective (e.g. Y: 6565 entries = 3036 vars + 3528 cons + 1 obj); a naming rule would silently misclassify exactly the *_def rows.
implementation_notes.interface_selection: families expected_interface_vmag / _pf_p / _pf_q, selected among 'v'-prefixed symbols only

mismatch_log_required_entries: TARGET_cycle20 interface axis recorded EQUIVALENT in P5_12_X_COMPARATOR_BREADTH_REPORT.md with no measurement behind it
TSO case9 interface axis recorded EQUIVALENT on expected_interface_vmag alone while _pf_p and _pf_q were present and uncompared
